proposal activities including task descriptions and basis of estimates that support price to win (PTW) targets. </li><li>Act as the Control Account Manager (CAM).  </li><li>Identify and secure supply chain resources to support capture plans. </li><li>Develop and execute material program plans (MPP). </li><li>Establish Material Sales Forecasts for assigned programs. </li><li>Execute make/buy/where demand. </li><li>Obtain MPM certification within 1 year of accepting this role.</li><li>Provide monthly forecasting/reporting and measuring of the ETC/VAC to AOP. </li><li>Identify and mitigate program risks and support weekly supplier meetings. </li><li>Domestic travel up to 20% of the time </li></ul><p><br /><b>Qualifications You Must Have </b></p><ul><li>Minimum 3 years experience in a
